samples.xml_description:
<module id="clkgenerator">
    <description>Generate a periodic clock signal.</description>
    <parameter_description>PERIOD = 10</parameter_description>
    <ports>
        <output id="clk">The output clock signal generated by the module.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Initializes clk to 0. Toggles clk every half of PERIOD.</implementation>
    
</module>
